draft.text: You came because you have been feeling short of breath, especially when walking or going up stairs.
You also mentioned swelling in both legs and foot pain in one foot, which went away after a few days.
No tests or exams were done during this visit.
Your shortness of breath and swelling could be related to your heart condition and chronic kidney disease.
The foot pain may be linked to your kidney disease or another condition, but it has already improved.
Blood tests will be ordered to check your heart and kidney function.
You will continue taking Lasix as prescribed.
You will need to follow up with your primary care doctor in a few days to talk about the test results and any next steps.
